levels.name: Frozen evidence
levels.meaning: Source excerpts with record IDs, baseline, revisions and text-time limits

levels.name: Typed relations
levels.meaning: Reference / semantic claim / membership / authorship / communication remain separate

levels.name: Structural features
levels.meaning: Distinct 1–3-hop reach; two-round neighbor-degree aggregation; betweenness; k-core

levels.name: Groups
levels.meaning: SCC condensation and three-resolution communities are structural; curated families are semantic annotations

levels.name: Hypotheses
levels.meaning: Candidate explanations require new adjudication or replay; never inserted as observed edges
